purpose: Convert OHLC history into causal structural episodes before any strategy hypothesis or profitability test.
campaign_v1_holdout_policy: FORBIDDEN. THE SEALED CAMPAIGN V1 HOLDOUT MUST NOT BE OPENED OR USED BY THIS ATLAS.

causality_contract.pivot_rule: A swing pivot is not observable at its extreme bar. It becomes confirmed only after price reverses by the frozen zigzag threshold. Both pivot_timestamp and confirmation_timestamp must be recorded.
causality_contract.support_resistance_rule: Only previously confirmed pivots may define a level/zone at a given timestamp.
causality_contract.indicator_rule: Descriptors use current and prior completed bars only.
causality_contract.outcome_rule: V1 atlas construction records no forward profitability label and performs no parameter selection by future returns.

episode_policy: Episodes are descriptive observations, not trades. Textbook names are secondary labels derived from objective primitives.
next_stage_rule: Only recurring primitives/episodes with adequate occurrence counts may later be converted into separately frozen hypotheses for the sealed certification kernel.
